scripts.build:server: npm run ensure:server-deps && cd ../desktop-server && npm run build
scripts.prepackage:core: node scripts/ensure-electron-dist.cjs && npm run compile && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop:ui && npm run install:server-deps && node scripts/prune-binaries.cjs && npm run prepare:resources && npm run sync:package-resources
scripts.prepackage:full: npm run install:python-venv && cross-env AIGENIUS_BUNDLE_PYTHON_VENV=1 npm run prepackage:core
scripts.prepackage:mac:full: npm run install:python-venv && cross-env AIGENIUS_BUNDLE_PYTHON_VENV=1 npm run prepackage:core
scripts.prepackage:win: npm run compile && npm run install:server-deps:win32 && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop:ui && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 node scripts/prune-binaries.cjs && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 npm run prepare:resources && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 npm run sync:package-resources
scripts.prepackage:win:arm64: npm run compile && npm run install:server-deps:win32-arm64 && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop:ui && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/prune-binaries.cjs && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 npm run prepare:resources && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 npm run sync:package-resources
scripts.prepackage:win:full: cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 npm run install:python-venv && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 AIGENIUS_BUNDLE_PYTHON_VENV=1 npm run prepackage:win
scripts.prepackage:linux:arm64: npm run compile && npm run install:server-deps:linux-arm64 && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop:ui && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=linux AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/prune-binaries.cjs && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=linux AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 npm run prepare:resources && cross-env AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=linux AIGENIUS_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 npm run sync:package-resources
scripts.package:mac:full: npm run prepackage:mac:full && electron-builder --mac -c.electronDist=../node_modules/electron/dist && npm run sync:web-download
scripts.package:mac:lite: npm run prepackage:mac && electron-builder --mac -c.electronDist=../node_modules/electron/dist && npm run sync:web-download
scripts.package:win:arm64: npm run prepackage:win:arm64 && npm run package:win:arm64:dir
scripts.package:linux:arm64: npm run prepackage:linux:arm64 && npm run package:linux:arm64:dir
scripts.dev:electron: npm run compile && npm run dev:electron:only
scripts.dev:electron:debug: npm run compile && cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 AIGENIUS_DESKTOP_DEVTOOLS=1 electron .
scripts.dev:quick: npm run compile && npm run dev:electron:only
scripts.dev: npm run build:server && npm run compile && npm run dev:electron:only
